description: Lists BRC cash receipts. entryDate is the accounting period date; procDate is the transaction/processing date. Customer and procDate filters use a complete bounded local scan (10,000 records), not upstream OData; narrow entryDate when needed.

companyName.description: Company context name, for example YOUR-COMPANY-NAME.

connectionRef.description: Opaque Red connection reference returned by brc_confirm_company_connection. Pass this exact value on every later tool call when the MCP client rotates session ids (for example Vibe/Mistral). Keep reusing the same connectionRef after successful tool calls — do not start a new connection because a lookup returned empty or partial data. It is not an API key and does not contain credentials.

customerCode.description: Exact case-sensitive code; bounded local filtering, no fuzzy match.

filter.description: Optional OData $filter using entryDate only. Other fields are unsupported.

orderBy.description: Optional OData $orderby expression, only if this endpoint supports ordering.

procDateFrom.description: Inclusive transaction date YYYY-MM-DD; local filtering.

procDateTo.description: Inclusive transaction date YYYY-MM-DD; local filtering.

name: brc_list_cash_receipts
title: List Cash Receipts
